text: {"domains":{"block_M":[32,64,128],"block_N":[64,128,256],"block_K":[32,64],"num_stages":[1,2,3,4],"threads":[128,256],"swizzle":[0,4,8,16,32,64]},"shared_memory_limit":32768,"weights":{"traffic":1,"launches":1,"pipeline":1,"footprint":1},"rationale":"Attempt-00 baseline selected 128x64x64,stages=1,threads=128,swizzle=0, passing numerical/SMT/compile and simulating at 470.78us with 3 blocks/SM. Shared cap 32768 implied estimate max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages,4*block_M*block_N); worked well so retained. Expanded swizzle to [0,4,8,16,32,64] to test panel-reuse hypothesis since M=4096 gives many tile rows. Added block_N=256 and num_stages=4 to probe wider N and deeper pipelines (HiGHS will reject infeasible smem combos). Added threads=256 alongside 128 to test the warp-layout/thread-domain hypothesis flagged by the proxy tie, early after baseline. Dropped none since exclusion is per-tuple, not per-value. Weights kept uniform for now; will downweight analytic traffic/footprint if measured simulator traffic/latency shows reuse gains not materializing. Next hypothesis: a swizzled panel or stages=2-3 with threads=256 reduces simulated latency versus the baseline 470.78us. Validation scope: Metal executes exact source/config/TIR; GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements."}
